orcaInp.studio.geometryGlobs.description: Globs of multi-XYZ trajectories and ensembles listed in the Geometries tab of Orbital Studio.

orcaInp.studio.geometryExcludeGlobs.description: Globs left out of the Geometries library (per-geometry calculation folders by default), in addition to orcaInp.runs.exclude.

orcaInp.studio.datGlobs.description: Globs of MD column files (energies.dat, temper.dat, est_energy.dat, ...) listed in the Trajectory (.dat) view of the Geometries tab.

orcaInp.studio.datExcludeGlobs.description: Globs left out of the Trajectory (.dat) file list (spectra and per-geometry folders by default), in addition to orcaInp.runs.exclude.

notes: Geometries tab (geom). 1) Redirect orcaInp.plotDat: in src/extension.ts replace the showDatPlot registration with `(uri?: vscode.Uri) => { const p = uri?.fsPath ?? vscode.window.activeTextEditor?.document.uri.fsPath; if (p) openStudio(context.extensionUri, 'geom', { dat: p }); }` (same command id, menus and icon stay). The tab opens its 'Trajectory (.dat)' sub-tab with that file; it reproduces every mdPlot feature (one panel per column on a shared time axis, wheel + drag zoom, double-click reset, dashed least-squares line, slope per ps for fs time columns, end - start of the visible range) and adds mean ± sd, τ_int and SEM. After the redirect src/features/mdPlot.ts (showDatPlot, datPlotHtml) has no callers and can be deleted; its only other import, linearFit, lives in src/chem/datFile.ts. No test imports it (checked: only src/extension.ts references showDatPlot). 2) A command can preselect XYZ files with openStudio(uri, 'geom', { xyz: [paths] }) (e.g. an explorer context entry on .xyz). 3) Host paths must be inside a workspace folder or picked through the tab's own 'Add files…' dialog (host method `pick`), so a .dat opened from outside the workspace via orcaInp.plotDat is rejected; if that matters, add a HostContext way to whitelist a path handed over by a command. 4) The .dat list no longer needs orcaInp.watchedCoordinates; the Distributions view reads it as its default coordinate list.
